scope: Read-only derivation using native controller source and recorded demo; no inverse-dynamics calibration claim
current_training_target_formula: interpolated observed future position minus observed reference, divided by position_divisor
interpretation: Observed reached pose and native desired setpoint are different quantities. Replaying reached poses through OSC is a tracking/control design problem, not the inverse of the original command sequence.
limits: This distinction is expected for dynamic/compliant control and is not by itself proof that reached-pose prediction cannot work. It invalidates assuming task-preserving action equivalence without an execution qualification.
